gloss: 热情 · 热忱 · 狂热

root.origin: 希腊语 zelos＝热忱、争胜心
root.sense: 胸口烧着一团不肯熄的火

scene.main: 一个人举着火把冲在最前面，火苗一圈圈向外蔓延，把身后的人一个个点亮
scene.sub: zel（热忱）→ 心里烧着火一样的热度：热情、热忱，走到极处就成了狂热。

examples.en: She tackled every task with {{w}} and never complained.
examples.cn: 她满腔热情地对待每一项任务，从不抱怨。

examples.en: His {{w}} for teaching inspired a whole generation.
examples.cn: 他对教学的热情激励了整整一代人。

examples.en: Too much {{w}} can turn a good idea into a crusade.
examples.cn: 过度的狂热会把好主意变成一场讨伐。

examples.en: The young volunteers worked with the {{w}} of new believers.
examples.cn: 年轻的志愿者们带着新信徒般的狂热工作。

pitfalls.text: zeal 只有四个字母，z-e-a-l，词尾没有 e。
zeal 读 /ziːl/，中间是长音 /iː/，不要读成 /zel/。
“对…的热情”用 zeal for，不用 zeal on 或 zeal to。

rows: 深沉热烈的感情或爱好
compare.chant: 热情 zeal，积极 enthusiasm，深爱 passion，过火 zealotry。

fills.sentence: She tackled every task with ___ and never complained.
His ___ for teaching inspired a whole generation.
fills.hint: 搭配 zeal for：对…的热情

fills.sentence: The audience applauded the young singer's ___ performance.
Critics warn that religious ___ can divide a community.
He worked ___ on the project for three months.

review: 说出 zeal 的 3 个搭配
默写 zel 词族 8 个词
遮住释义，复述火把蔓延的画面
writeSample: Keep your zeal for learning, but let patience carry it the last mile.
